property_summary: If an address is set approved via setApprovedLogger, then approvedToLog must return true for that address (i.e., approval is not inverted).
If a caller is not an approved logger, calls that require approval (e.g. logFunded) return false rather than true.
For any caller address X, if X is not approved via setApprovedLogger then no log* call by X returns true (i.e., only explicitly approved addresses can successfully emit logs).

If an address A is set approved via setApprovedLogger by the caller, then approvedToLog(A) returns true for that address (i.e., approval is stored per-address and independent of who is the contract owner).
If any address is marked approved via setApprovedLogger by the test caller, then approvedToLog returns true for that address when queried by anyone.
If an address was marked approved via setApprovedLogger, calling approvedToLog for that address returns true regardless of who the caller (msg.sender) is.
Once an address is enabled via setApprovedLogger by any caller, querying approvedToLog for that address (via the public getter) must return true regardless of who is calling approvedToLog.

For every address x, approvedToLog(x) returns approvedLoggers[x] (i.e., only the approvedLoggers mapping determines approval); the mutant incorrectly treats the contract owner as always approved, causing approvedToLog(owner) to be true even when approvedLoggers[owner] is false.

For every address a, approvedToLog(a) equals the stored mapping approvedLoggers[a] (i.e., only mapping controls approval); the mutant breaks this by making the contract owner implicitly approved regardless of the mapping.

For every address x, C.approvedToLog(x) returns the stored mapping approvedLoggers[x] (so it can be true for some x); the mutant always returns false breaking that when an address is approved (mapping true) exists.

For any address a, C.approvedToLog(a) always returns the value of the contract's approvedLoggers mapping for that address; the mutant that always returns false will disagree whenever an address has been set approved (true).
